text: SUPERVISOR — URGENT USER VERDICT before you finish: RAMPSIDE FAILS, verbatim: "uh. ramps, broken now. i cant even walk up them. seems they made them entirely blocked off". Your side/back wall-class bands are blocking the SLOPE itself — the character cannot walk up a ramp at all. The catalog rule was hard cover from the far side and solid SIDES — the walk-up face and the slope surface must remain fully walkable. If your commit has not landed yet: fix this FIRST, then commit the cluster in a working state. If it already landed: fix forward immediately in a follow-up commit — no revert. Print the ramp registration again (the bands vs the slope heightfield footprint) and show which band intrudes into the approach/slope path — likely the low/back band covers the entry edge or the band height exceeds step height at the slope base. Walk-up must work in the witness (character ascends the slope, blocked only on sides/back) before you post READY. The user's walk-up is the PASS.
resolution: The ramp walk-up failure was fixed forward by moving the hard cover band from the low approach edge to the far/high face. The witness now prints side/far bands against the slope heightfield, shows the old approach band as the intruder, and verifies the character ascends from the ramp base to the crest while only the sides/back block.
